washington-first-inauguration.description: A man in a dark brown coat with his back and profile to the viewer stands on a stone balcony with an iron railing. He rests one hand on a book on a red cushion held by a younger man in brown. Behind them, several men in dark clothing and wide-brimmed hats stand in a dense crowd below and to the left, with columns, a classical building and two small flags in the background. The image fills the frame edge to edge.

john-adams-inauguration.description: A painted interior of a wood-panelled room with a brick wall and a pedimented doorway. A man in a dark 18th-century suit with a white jabot and powdered wig raises his right hand and touches a book held by a man in a black robe with white bands. Seated and standing men in powdered wigs and period coats fill the room, and a tall man in a dark coat stands at the right. A wooden desk and papers are in the middle distance, and the frame is edge to edge with no text.

jefferson-first-inauguration.description: A tall man in a black tricorn hat and dark coat walks across a muddy, rubble-strewn clearing with tree stumps. Behind him, a half-built classical stone building with scaffolding and a timber frame rises on the right. Several men in period dress with tricorn hats follow in the background. The sky is heavy and overcast, and the painting fills the frame edge to edge with no text or border.

madison-first-inauguration.description: A man in a dark coat and waistcoat raises his right hand while another man in a dark overcoat holds a book. They stand in a dark wood-panelled chamber with a domed, arched ceiling and a skylight. A woman in a pale empire-style gown and turban sits in a gallery at upper left, and a few men in period dress stand around the room.

monroe-first-inauguration.description: A man in a dark early-19th-century suit with a white cravat stands on a raised wooden platform, hand resting on a book on a stand, while an older man in a black robe with white hair raises his other hand. Behind them, a row of older men in period coats stands on the platform beside a red brick building with multi-pane windows. A large crowd of men in top hats and women in bonnets fills the open ground under a pale sky with clouds.

john-quincy-adams-inauguration.description: A balding older man in a black frock coat and bow tie raises his right hand and rests his left on a large leather-bound book, while a man in a black judicial robe with white hair faces him and gestures. They stand in a grand chamber with dark marble columns, red and gold drapes, and a tiered gallery of seated and standing onlookers. A tall window with light falls behind them, and a seated man in a dark suit is at the left edge. Papers lie on the table, and the scene reads as 19th-century American in dress and furnishings.

jackson-first-inauguration.description: A crowded, chaotic interior: a man in a dark suit and waistcoat stands on a upholstered chair, raising a top hat with one arm. Around him a mob of rough-dressed men in brown coats and slouch hats presses in, some climbing toward tall open windows on the right. A punch bowl has tipped off a round table on the left, spilling liquid and shards of white china across the floor, with food scraps and dropped hats nearby. Gilt-framed portraits hang on the papered walls under a crystal chandelier. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no text or signature visible.

william-henry-harrison-inauguration.description: An elderly man with grey hair and a dark overcoat with a black cravat stands on snowy stone steps, holding a thick stack of papers and speaking. Behind him, a crowd of men in top hats and winter coats stands before a neoclassical building with tall columns, and snow or sleet falls through the scene.

polk-inauguration.description: An oil-style painting of a rainy scene. In the foreground a dark wooden desk holds a quill and inkwell, handwritten papers, and a brass telegraph key beside a brass paper-tape machine whose tape spills off the desk. Through a rain-streaked window, a large crowd of people under dark umbrellas fills the middle ground, facing a neoclassical building with columns, a balcony and stairs, where a small group of figures stands. The sky is grey and overcast, with bare trees at left. No legible text is visible.

lincoln-first-inauguration.description: A tall, bearded man in a dark frock coat stands on a wooden platform, one arm raised, reading from pages on a lectern. Behind him a large domed white building with an unfinished, scaffolded dome and a construction crane. A dense crowd of men in top hats and dark coats fills the foreground, with soldiers in dark kepis holding rifles on the platform and a few armed figures on a balcony at right. The sky is heavy and overcast, and no text is visible.

grant-first-inauguration.description: A painting of a bearded man in a dark suit with one hand raised on a raised platform before a columned classical building, with a crowd of dark-uniformed men holding rifles and flags in the foreground. Stormy grey sky at upper left, several American flags, and a second building on the left. Dark, muted oil-painting palette. No visible text.

cleveland-first-inauguration.description: A moustached man in a dark frock coat raises his right hand while his left rests on a book held by an older man in a black judicial robe, on a columned portico. Behind them is a white domed building, likely the US Capitol. A large crowd in hats fills the lower left, with American flags and red, white and blue bunting on balconies. Late 19th-century dress. No visible text.
